//: Only site/ is deployed. The API in src/ and the operator console in
public/ are deliberately NOT here: the console calls /v1 endpoints that
approve real payments, and publishing those would put an approve button on
the open internet. They stay on a machine that holds the keys.
Vercel serves a root-level public/ directory by convention, and this repo
has one that is not meant to be public, so outputDirectory is set
explicitly and .vercelignore excludes everything else as a second guard.
